adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, `refreshOAuthTokens` in packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts returns either the result of `fetch()` (a native Response object) when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true, or the result of `refreshFunction()`. In GoogleCalendarService, the refreshFunction returns `fetchTokens.res` which is the Google API response. When in sync mode (APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED=true), the function returns a native Fetch Response which has no `.data` property - it has `.json()` method instead. Line 94 does `const token = res?.data;` which would be undefined for a native Response, causing line 95-96 to set googleCredentials.access_token and expiry_date to undefined. The catch block at line 108 returns myGoogleAuth without re-throwing, so the caller gets an auth object with stale/undefined credentials, masking the actual failure.
